passage.title: Model answer written for TGA
paras: Shakespeare presents forgiveness as the harder, nobler choice. [Point] When Prospero declares that 'The rarer action is / In virtue than in vengeance', [Evidence] he uses alliteration to set two choices side by side. [Technique] The adjective 'rarer' suggests mercy is precious because so few choose it. [Zoom in] Prospero could punish his enemies, but he chooses to break the cycle of betrayal. [Analyse] However, Antonio's silence suggests that forgiveness may not change everyone. [Alternative] Ultimately, Shakespeare shows that forgiveness is a sign of strength, not weakness. [Link]
